message.content: {"caption":"VERA’s diagram links sandbox construction, rubric-based judging, and environment synthesis into a verified training workflow.","description":"A three-part process diagram. (1) Verified environments, task queries, and history context are combined to create training sandboxes, with counts shown as 4,567 CoWork and 4,864 Med. (2) Automated rubrics cover Skill, Tool, and Trajectory inputs; an Agent Judge checks skill and tool schemas, argument validity, execution effects, artifact evidence, and contextual output quality. (3) CoWork and Med benchmark trajectories feed agent trajectories and a coding-agent workflow with plan, setup, verify, execute, and submit stages. The diagram shows both an end-to-end environment, supported by an LLM surrogate, and a stage-wise environment with S1–S5 queries and displayed scores of 70, 81, 65, 90, and 75. Both paths are shown being verified by the Agent Judge.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
